text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One holiday. Stay Gold had apparently 
gotten her hands on some delicious meat 
from her travels—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Food tastes better when everyone digs in 
together, right? Alright, let's fire up 
the BBQ!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...! This meat is delicious!! I feel like 
I could eat this forever!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you've got a sharp eye choosing that 
meat. I was told when I caught it that 
it's packed with extra nutrients.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Wait, when it was caught? Did Stego-san do 
this?!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you're interested? Well then, care 
to hear that story over our meal?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*munch, chew*... Phew, that was so 
interesting! Hearing the story makes the 
meat taste even deeper and more flavorful!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Heh, having someone to talk to was fun for 
me, too.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Wait, huh?! Look at all these 
plates! This might be a new big-eating 
record for me...?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Stego-saaan! Won't you have some 
grilled meat before you go? We've got 
quite a bit left over!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"The more I grilled, the better I felt I 
was getting! It actually started getting 
really fun!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm. Hey, wanna switch who's grilling?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, don't worry about it! I do it 
because I enjoy it! As long as you get to 
eat some delicious meat—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I'm just taking a break from eating. If 
you're refusing to switch places no matter 
what, then—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Even if I have to blow you away, I'm going 
to stand there.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Mmm!! So delicious!! You're really good at 
grilling meat, Stego-san!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Would it grill better if I took more 
time? ...Maybe I should add a few more 
variations to the seasoning, too."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
! You're really into it! ...Wait, you're 
grilling way too many at once!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
What a magnificent space...!! What a 
luxurious time...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The meat and carrots are for everyone 
else! Leftovers are more than enough for 
the likes of me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? Stego-san is glaring over 
here... Wait, is that... fa—fan service!?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't just stand off in the corner 
all by yourself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haua?! N-No no no no no no! Um, well, over 
there is blinding—no, too awe-inspiring, 
so, um!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
You should go to the center too. I can't 
help but worry seeing you standing on the 
edge alone.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I'm in the mood for a lively meal 
together. Didn't I tell you that at the 
start? Come on, get over here.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "Guh...!! ...Su-such... kind... ness..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she acts completely self-centered, 
she unconsciously creates a fun and lively 
atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Or so I thought, but—

text_block_list.name: Pocket & Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah!? ...What's your problem?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've timed these to grill just right. 
Don't go grabbing 'em based on your own 
damn logic.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, it's already cooked, so who 
cares! Grab it quick or it's gonna get 
tough!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, both of you. Isn't this supposed 
to be a fun BBQ?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Still, though!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...I'll say this one more time.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: A fun BBQ, right?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: And so, why not try this—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Why not settle it with a race, like true 
Umamusume? Some exercise after eating.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Still, having just the two of us is a bit 
boring. —I know, how about getting 
everyone to join in?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An impromptu beach race kicked off. 
Everyone eagerly joined in.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!! If we're doing this, I'm 
taking the top spot for sure!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna show everyone that I've been 
growing too! Alright, let's do this!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, Digital-chan! We're up next, you know!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Running across the sparkling sandy beach 
with everyone...! This is youth... the 
very sight of it...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! That's it, that's it! Keep it up!
choice_data_list: Aren't you going out for a run?
Aren't you going for a run?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! That's it, that's it! Keep it up!
choice_data_list: Aren't you going out for a run?
Aren't you going for a run?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hm? Well, that's—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Of course I'm going! It sounds super fun!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Of course having a good time is better! 
That goes for you too!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Have even more fun! Hey, do you 
wanna join in on the beach race too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led along by a high-spirited Stay Gold, I 
ended up running along the sandy beach.
